charset.bytes.test: create publishes UTF-8 stylesheet bytes without a BOM or encoding declaration

charset.packed.test: compile retains Unicode, import ordering, and source maps without a BOM or charset contribution

function.integer.test: compile rejects non-integer token 1px in source and packed calls

function.packed.test: compile retains composite signatures and default invocation across packed re-exports

namespace.binding.test: compile resolves equivalent escaped prefixes using the last module binding and retains packed maps

namespace.rendering.test: compile keeps empty and default namespaces distinct in Chromium

namespace.uri.test: compile preserves namespace URI control characters through packed output and native matching

namespace.watch.test: create rebuilds Unicode namespace bindings and preserves unrelated module scopes

page.margins.test: compile retains every margin box and its source call through a packed library dependency

page.rendering.test: compile prints named pages, pseudo-pages, counters, and all sixteen margin boxes

page.watch.test: create replaces all page-margin contents without retaining stale declarations

print.icc.test: compile paints packed ICC references and reports unsupported relative-profile rendering

print.marks.test: compile prints packed bleed and marks with independent geometry and raster controls

profile.origin.test: compile retains referenced origins before relative profile names in packed output

profile.packed.test: compile preserves profile components and color expressions across packed aliases

profile.references.test: compile rejects a profile interpolated outside color()

transition.capture.test: compile captures navigation, activates declared types, and obeys conditional opt-out
